question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

ZEALOUS
solution:
The correct answer is **Indifferent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• 
 The meaning of: 

 
 
• 
 **Zealous:** showing a strong desire to get something done. (कुछ करने की तीव्र इच्छा दिखाना।)

 
 
• 
 **For example,** He thought the reporters were too zealous in their attempts to get into the event.
 
 
 
 
• 
 Indifferent: not interested in or caring about somebody (किसी में दिलचस्पी या परवाह नहीं करना)

 
 
• For example, The manager of the shop seemed indifferent to our complaints
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• 
 The meaning of:

 
 
• 
 **Eager:** strongly wanting to have something. (कुछ पाने की प्रबल इच्छा।)

 
 
• 
 ​**For example,** the man was eager to please
 
 
 
 
• 
 **Anxious:** worried and afraid. (चिंतित और भयभीत) 

 
 
• 
 **For example,** I began to get anxious when they still hadn’t arrived at 9 o’clock.
 
 
 
 
• 
 **Annoyed:** feeling angry. (गुस्सा आ रहा है.)

 
 
• 
 **For example,** I shall be extremely annoyed if he turns up late again.
 
 
 
 
 

 
• 
 Therefore, from the meanings of the words given above the correct answer is Indifferent.
 
 
• 
 Hence, the correct option is **2**.
